api_base.description: The Noma API base URL. Defaults to https://api.noma.security.

api_key.description: The Noma API key. Reads from NOMA_API_KEY env var if None.

application_id.description: The Noma Application ID. Reads from NOMA_APPLICATION_ID env var if None.

block_failures.description: When true, fail closed on Noma API errors.

gateway_name.description: Gateway name, used as the gateway_host label on Noma scans. Falls back to NOMA_GATEWAY_NAME.

monitor_mode.description: When true, run guardrail checks in monitor mode.
